name: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Existing Service Tampering
description: Detects the modification of an existing service in order to execute an arbitrary payload when the service is started or killed as a potential method for persistence.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.command_line:*sc\ * AND process.command_line:*config\ * AND process.command_line:*binpath\=*) OR (process.command_line:*sc\ * AND process.command_line:*failure* AND process.command_line:*command\=*)) OR (((process.command_line:*reg\ * AND process.command_line:*add\ * AND process.command_line:*FailureCommand*) OR (process.command_line:*reg\ * AND process.command_line:*add\ * AND process.command_line:*ImagePath*)) AND (process.command_line:(*.sh* OR *.exe* OR *.dll* OR *.bin$* OR *.bat* OR *.cmd* OR *.js* OR *.msh$* OR *.reg$* OR *.scr* OR *.ps* OR *.vb* OR *.jar* OR *.pl*)))
